tool.name: nf-core syri
tool.description: Syri compares alignments between two chromosome-level assemblies and identifies synteny and structural rearrangements.
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ syri \\ -c $infile \\ -q $query_fasta \\ -r $reference_fasta \\ -F $file_type \\ $args \\ --prefix $prefix \\ 2>| >(tee "${prefix}.error.log" >&2) \\ || echo "Errors from syri printed to ${prefix}.error.log"
[ -f "${prefix}syri.out" ] \\ && rm "${prefix}.error.log" \\ || echo 'Syri failed and no syri.out file was created'
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": syri: \$(syri --version) END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
Syri compares alignments between two chromosome-level assemblies and identifies synteny and structural rearrangements.
